title: Ya Rasool Allah Sws
body:
Dafn Jab Kar Ne Lage Lasha E Zahra (sa) mola
Roke Be-Sakhta E Kehte the Hasan Ke Baba
Ya Rasool Allah Ya Habib Allah
Rokey Be Sakhta kehty Thy Hassan k Baba
1) Apki Zahra Pe Kya kya Na Mazalim Dhaye
Dar E Zahra ko Jalane ko Sitamgar aye
Thokaren Mar ke Dar zahra pe girwaya gaya
2) Apki Zahra Thi Jalte Huwe Darwaze Taley
Aur Qadam Rakhte Hue Uspe Sitamgar Guzre
Haye Is Zulm Pe Mehshar Na huwa kiu barpa
3) Maine lamhat guzare Wo sunau kese
Kis tarha Zabt kiya maine bataun kese
Jis ghari zehra ko zalim ne Tamacha mara
4) Apki Zahra Gayi Barsare Darbar e Nabi
Karke Tehrir ko para they tamaskhur main shaki
Apki zahra ko darbar main Jhutlaya gaya
5) Apki Zahra ka Pehlu Tha Shikasta mola
Gusl Jab dete huwe mai ne ye manzar Dekha
Zabt Bhi Fatahe khaybar se nahi ho paya
6) Jis ghari louti thi'n darbar se meri bibi,,,
Qalb phat ta tha kamar uski jhuki jab dekhi
Haal kya kar dia ghasib ne meri bibi
7) Haye ro ro k the ye bayen Ali Haidar k
Sath dene ko chale aaiye moula mere
Lasha E zahra ko tanha nahi dafna sakta.
